title: Pondering Pebble-Puffer
statement: A plump, star-freckled pufferfish with wide, inquisitive eyes that drifts gently through clear teal water, puffing soft currents to sort smooth pebbles and tumbled sea-glass into tidy, shifting constellations. Its quiet sanctuary is dappled with warm amber sunbeams filtering through swaying ribbon-kelp and mossy slate ledges, inviting the calm wonder of an afternoon spent browsing a sunlit library.
